 In Ohio, the campaign for Vivek Ramaswamy is facing backlash over a controversial attack ad featuring the estranged mother of his Democratic opponent, Amy Acton. Acton, who has been estranged from her birth mother for nearly 50 years, alleges her mother stayed married to a man who abused her as a child. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY. Oct. 21, 2026
